author: Jignesh_N

title: Best tour to start your visit to Barcelona!
text: If we could rate this 10 stars we would. First, the gothic quarter is the perfect place to learn about the history of the Barcelona. Andrew, our guide was fantastic — full of information and stories that we will remember long past our tour. It was simple to meet up in the Plaza de L’Angel and a short walk to most of the tour highlights. This is a wonderful opportunity for anyone looking to spend a couple hours strolling beautiful streets while taking in some entertaining anecdotes and stories. Thank you!
